meta.name: acquisition-channel-advisor
meta.description: Evaluate acquisition channels using unit economics, customer quality, and scalability. Use when deciding whether to scale, test, or kill a growth channel.

copy.tagline: 评估获客渠道的投入产出与可扩展性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在决定是否加大或放弃某个增长渠道
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate acquisition channels by unit economics and scalability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're deciding whether to scale or kill a growth channel

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你评估一个获客渠道是否值得继续投入。它会问你关于获客成本、客户终身价值、客户留存率和可扩展性的问题，然后给出“大力投入”、“测试优化”或“放弃”的建议。
howto.when: 当你需要决定是否要为一个获客渠道增加预算、比较不同渠道的质量，或者判断是否应该停止某个渠道时，可以调用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我评估一下付费LinkedIn广告这个渠道。
say.note: 技能会开始询问相关数据。

say.text: 比较内容营销、外发邮件和合作伙伴推荐这三个渠道。
say.note: 技能会逐一评估并对比。

say.text: 我们该不该停止网络研讨会这个获客渠道？
say.note: 技能会分析数据给出建议。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through evaluating an acquisition channel. It asks about CAC, LTV, retention, and scalability, then recommends whether to scale, test, or kill the channel.
howto.when_en: Use this when deciding whether to increase budget for a channel, comparing channel quality, or deciding whether to stop a channel.

say_en.note: The skill will start asking for data.

say_en.text: Compare content marketing, outbound email, and partner referrals.
say_en.note: The skill will evaluate each and compare.

say_en.text: Should we kill our webinar acquisition channel?
say_en.note: The skill will analyze and recommend.
